zh.summary: 收敛为单一 Portable 更新线，展示最新 3 个已验收官方内核，并改进更新兼容提示与体积基线说明。
highlights: Portable 仅使用 stable 更新目录；旧 candidate 设置会静默归一，旧候选用户可升级到正式单线版本。
设置页移除 Stable/Candidate 选择器，保留内核版本选择和其他不可用版本的折叠说明；README 改为单列展示最新 3 个已验证内核。
当 Portable 版本比目标内核要求更新时，提示改为说明该内核尚未针对当前 Portable 完成验证，不再错误要求升级 Portable（3911879）。
footprint 评估以最近正式版基线作相对比较，而不使用固定体积阈值（bae534b）。
upgradeNotes: 旧 launcher-settings.json 中的 stable/candidate 值会静默规范为 stable；旧 --channel candidate 参数继续作为兼容别名。设置与用户数据保持不变。
内核目录最多展示 3 个已验收版本。
knownIssues: 全平台 Build and smoke test 与旧 candidate 用户升级验收仍需在 GitHub CI 完成。

en.summary: Consolidate Portable onto one release line, show the newest three qualified official cores, and improve update-compatibility messaging and footprint baselines.
highlights: Portable now uses only the stable update feed; legacy candidate settings are silently normalized, allowing existing candidate users to upgrade to the single public line.

The Settings page removes the Stable/Candidate selector while retaining core selection and the expandable unavailable-version summary; the README now uses one column for the newest three verified cores.
When Portable is newer than a core target, the message now says that core is not yet verified for the current Portable instead of incorrectly asking users to upgrade Portable (3911879).
Footprint evaluation compares against the previous stable release baseline instead of fixed size limits (bae534b).
upgradeNotes: Legacy stable/candidate values in launcher-settings.json are silently normalized to stable. The old --channel candidate argument remains a compatibility alias. Settings and user data are preserved.
The core catalog is limited to the newest three qualified versions.
knownIssues: The all-platform Build and smoke test and legacy candidate-to-single-line upgrade acceptance still require GitHub CI verification.
